title: phoebe excelsa
intro: Phoebe excelsa, commonly known as the Malabar tree or Indian centella, is a medicinal plant native to Asia, particularly in China, India, and Southeast Asia. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The plant's therapeutic actions include its analgesic, anti-bacterial, and anti-viral properties, which make it effective in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Phoebe excelsa include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
